runtime: Standalone single-thread Cell CPU, Apple M3 Max, rustc 1.94.0, release --locked; same frozen 64-unit schedule and view-ports in each paired test.

methods.broad: One fresh CLI and output directory per sample. D0..3 are rotated each round; odd rounds reversed. 7 rounds on sum-bits and 3 on Raytrace. Audit/profile runs excluded from medians.
methods.selected: Training uses all D3 resumed LHS survey port reads, summed by direction-sensitive table names and columns. Emit the 8 most frequent paths of each of length 2 and 3 with lexicographic ties. Execute on the opposite workload. 7 and 5 paired rounds alternating D0 and selected. Each packet and all partial suffix states share the eight-reference bound.
methods.audit: SHA-256 equals stored baselines on every Run of RHS, effective writes and Spine resume digests and trajectory, plus schedule and exported state. Stages, applied RHS counts and uninterrupted chain lengths are counted separately.
methods.histograms: Within one experiment bins identify structural path length. Cumulative depth coverage uses separate D1/D2/D3 surveys; a downstream port can also depend on fields supplied through another path. Oracle owner reads were zero in both workloads.
